what: In the Hero a small 3:4 portrait window in the center (height min(37cqh, 82cqw), top 20.6cqh) grows to fill the screen while passing through a 280svh section. It is fully grown at 70% of section height − screen height, with cubic in-out progress. The video inside sinks from 1.6x to 1x, and the logo and text below the window fade out quickly with opacity 1 − 2.6p while rising 2.5rem. Once progress passes .5, [data-fx-part=meta] gets is-over added (text takes the color over the video). Pressing the window (Enter·Space) switches the channel to the next number, a static noise flashes for .42s step-end (once more when the new video is ready or after 300ms), and a CH number blinks for .2s at the window’s top left and stays for 1.6s. Below window height 620px or with reduced motion, it stands without pinning

options.span: Share of the fixed range used for full growth, default .7
options.channels: Number of channels that spin on press, default 4 — <video data-channels="a.mp4,b.mp4"> Given this, swaps the src in that order
options.low: Does not grow in windows shorter than this height (px), default 620
options.--fx-pwg-zoom: Initial zoom amount of the inner video (css variable), default .6 (1.6x)

use:
CH 01

Logo
Clock
note: When a video (data-channels) ends, it moves on to the next channel video without static — no loop attribute is set. On channel change it fires fx:channel(detail.channel). The static texture comes from --fx-grain(url), and if missing the part makes gray noise

from.where: index.html hero (original brand-hero — 280svh · 70% range cubic in-out · video 1.6 → 1 · channel glitch .42s)
